scientific_integrity: Theorem established by explicit C1 scalar vector-field construction; derivatives, flow multipliers, basin minimality and sharpness proved. Finite algebraic checks supplement the proof; no independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional orientation-preserving C1 flows fixing K pointwise; not a C2 statement, not a classification of all attractor maps, and no claim about arbitrary dynamics within K. Historical priority risk remains.
title: Sharp multiplier and basin-split realization of closed Milnor attractors by interval flows
